relics._notes: Map-placed, unbuildable. Capture/study for unique bonuses. Great late-game objectives in multiplayer.

list.name: Guardian of Forever
list.effect: One-time temporal action: undo a lost battle or rewind a colony.

list.name: Iconian Gateway
list.effect: Teleports ships/troops to any visible system; dangerous if left open.

list.name: Dyson Sphere
list.effect: Enormous habitable interior and energy; very hard to enter.

list.name: Caretaker-type Array
list.effect: Pulls a random fleet across the galaxy; can be controlled or destroyed.

list.name: Celestial Temple (Wormhole)
list.effect: Stable wormhole; Bajoran-faith morale; Prophets/Pah-wraith events.

list.name: Genesis Planet
list.effect: Rich, unstable world — rapid regeneration effects, then collapse.
